axes_source: Read from data/brands/opencode.ai.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #201D1D and the canvas #FDFCFC; contrast from the ink #201D1D on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #201D1D; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 0, 4px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #201D1D reaches 16.34:1 on the canvas #FDFCFC, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
name: OpenCode
